Over 60 years of delivering precision in Alloy Steel Casting

About Us

Started in 1964 with an aim to make India self-reliant in its need for strong alloy steel, NITIN Castings has made significant strides in the industry over the last 60 years, and today manufactures and supplies alloy steel castings that meet the highest global standards. Our products and services have gained widespread admiration from some of the world’s leading names across several core industries - a testament to our commitment and quality standards.


NITIN Castings’ contribution to the industry significantly increased as the years passed by and with growing demands, NITIN Castings entered into a 15+ years technical collaboration with M/S Schmidt + Clemens of Germany a global leader known for its high-quality steel solutions.

Read More

Centrifugal Castings

A process specially developed to manufacture cylindrical shapes, where molten metal is introduced at high speed into a metallic mould, enabling the metal to solidify into cylindrical shapes under centrifugal force.

Read More

Sand Castings

A process that manufactures steel castings for heat, corrosion, and wear resistance applications. The process manufactures castings by using a box-less 2-part sand machine moulding process.

Read More

Shell Moulded Castings

A moulding process that uses metallic patterns and resin-coated sand to produce shell moulds. The process is optimized for better mould quality by adjusting metal pattern temperature, sand holding time & mould curing.

Read More

Investment Castings

A manufacturing process that allows parts to be customized to suit its function without compromising on the quality and overcoming manufacturing limitations.

Read More

FAQs

  • NITIN Castings specializes in manufacturing high-quality alloy steel castings, heat-resistant castings, centrifugal castings, sand castings, shell moulded castings, and investment castings for industrial applications.

  • NITIN Castings offers over 60 years of foundry experience, advanced manufacturing facilities, strict quality assurance, customized engineering solutions, and reliable industrial performance.

  • Yes, the company manufactures customized castings based on customer drawings, technical specifications, and application requirements.

  • Yes, customized alloy compositions and special material grades can be developed depending on industrial operating conditions and customer requirements.

  • Yes, the company handles both low-volume specialized requirements and bulk industrial production orders.

  • NITIN Castings serves both domestic and international industrial customers across multiple sectors globally.

  • Industries such as petrochemicals, refineries, steel plants, cement plants, fertilizer plants, power plants, and industrial furnaces widely use alloy steel castings.

  • Centrifugal casting is mainly used for cylindrical components with high density and strength, while sand casting is suitable for complex and larger industrial shapes.

  • Investment casting and shell mould casting are commonly preferred for precision components with tight tolerances and smooth surface finish.

  • NITIN Castings manufactures reformer tubes, radiant tubes, furnace rolls, tray assemblies, and other high-temperature resistant industrial components.
